extension.summary: FluidDev - Dynamic Research & Code Extraction Platform
extension.description: Advanced modular research platform for Kodi addon development. Features: Dynamic module discovery with enable/disable, Environment abstraction (Kodi/Dev), Template registry with 30+ templates, AST-based pattern extraction, Execution flow tracing, Code generalization & cleaning, Reusable bundle generation, AI-style handoff reports, Interactive template wizard, Side-by-side addon comparison. Modules auto-discover from filesystem - add new modules without code changes.
extension.news: v1.1.0 - Major Architecture Overhaul - NEW: Dynamic module discovery - modules auto-detected from filesystem - NEW: Environment abstraction layer - clean Kodi/Dev separation - NEW: Template registry system - unified template management - NEW: Module manager - enable/disable modules on the fly - NEW: Interactive template wizard - IMPROVED: Blind entry router - zero logic, pure routing - IMPROVED: Config handles all environment differences - IMPROVED: Main menu dynamically builds from enabled modules - FIXED: Proper vfs abstraction for cross-environment compatibility
